name: asset-handover
title: IT asset handover
for_each: select id,name from assets where state='active' order by name

sections.title: Recovery instructions
sections.sql: select b.name,b.version,r.steps,b.state,b.due_on,coalesce(b.current_review,false) as current_review from runbook_status b join runbooks r on r.id=b.id join runbook_assets l on l.runbook_id=b.id where l.asset_id=$1 order by b.name

sections.title: Outstanding work
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_on from tasks where asset_id=$1 and state='open' order by due_on

name: runbook-review
title: Runbook review record
for_each: select id,name from runbooks order by name

sections.title: Procedure
sections.sql: select name,purpose,owner,version,steps from runbooks where id=$1

sections.title: Review history
sections.sql: select version,reviewer,reviewed_on,due_on,evidence from reviews where runbook_id=$1 order by reviewed_on,created_at

sections.title: Open checks
sections.sql: select name,rule,issue,source from compliance_items where $1::uuid is not null order by rule,name
